paite: Johan sang in Jesu'n nungzui tamzaw abawl a, tam abaptis zaw chih Pharisaite'n aza uh chih Toupa'n atheih in.
heading: Jesu Leh Samari Numei

paite: (Jesu hial in zaw abaptis kei a, anungzuite'n abaptis zaw zel uh),
Judia gam paisan in, Galili gam ah akik nawnta hi.
Huchi in Samaria gam tawn a pai akul hi.
Huchi in Samaria gam khua khat, Saikar achih uh, Jakob in atapa Joseph kiang a mun apiakna kiang ahong tung hi.
Huai ah Jakob tuileh a-om hi. Huchi in Jesu apaigim ziak in tuileh gei ah atu a; huai hun dak gukna khawng ahi.
Huchi in Samari numei khat tui tawi in ahong kuan a, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Dawn ding hon pia in," achi hi.
(Anungzuite lah nek ding lei in khua ah ahoh ngal ua).

Huchi in Samari numei in akiang ah, "Nang Juda mi hi chin a, kei Samari numei hi ing a, bangchidan a ka kiang a dawn ding hon ngen na hia? achi hi. Judate'n lah Samari mite bangmah in angai ngal kei ua," achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian thilthawnpiak leh dawn ding hon pia in, na kiang a chipa thei leteh zaw nang akiang a ngen zaw ding hi chin a, ama'n tuihing hon pe ding hiven," achi hi.
Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, akhaikhiakna ding bangmah lah na nei kei a, tuileh athukthuk toh, koi a kipan in ahia huai tuihing na muh ding?
Ka pu uh Jakob sang in na thupizaw a hia? Ama'n hiai tuileh hon pia a, amah leh atate leh agante'n leng adawn uhi,” achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh hiai tui dawn adangtak nawn ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
"Kuapeuh akiang a ka piak ding tui dawn bel, dangtak nawn ngei lou ding a; akiang a tui ka piak ding pen amah ah tui nak ahong phulkhe ding a, tangtawn hinpha a kikhohtou ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, huai tui hon pe ve, ka dangtak nawnlouhna ding leh hiai tantan a tui tawi ding a ka hong kuanlouhna ding in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai inla, na pasal va sam inla, hiai ah hong kik nawn in,” achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, “Pasal ka nei sam a," chi in adawng hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pasal ka nei sam a, na chih zaw, na chi dik ve;
pasal nga na neita a, tua na neihpa pen na pasal ahi kei him ahi, hiai thu na chi dik ve,” achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Pu, zawlnei na hi chih ka thei hi.
Kou pipute'n hiai tang ah Pathian abe zel ua; nou bel mihing in Pathian abiakna mun ding Jerusalem khua ahi, na chi sese ua," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, kei hon gingta in, hiai tang chitchiat lou leh Jerusalem khua chitchiat lou ah leng Pa na biak hun uh atungta hi.
Nou na theih louhpi uh na be nak ua, kou zaw ka theih uh ka bia uh; hotdamna lah Judate a kipan ahi ngal a.
Himahleh Pathian be taktakte'n kha leh thutak a Pa abiak hun uh tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lel hi, Pa'n huchibang mi abemi ding in azong hi.
Pathian zaw Kha ahi a, abemite'n kha leh thutak a abiak ngeingei ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Messia, Khrist akichi, ahong pai ding chih ka thei, amah ahong pai chiang in bangkim ahon hilh ding," achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Keimah nang hon houpihpa, huai amah ka hi," achi hi.
Huan huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, numei ahoupih lamdang asa mahmah uhi; himahleh kuamah in, "Bang zong na hia? Bangziak a numei houpih?" achi kei uh.
heading: Nungzuite Thuhilhna

paite: Numei in atuibel apaisan a, khua ah ava pai a, mite kiang ah,
"Ка thilhih peuh hon hilh zel mi khat a-om, hong unla, en dih uh; Khrist ahihtheih tuak na hiam?" achi hi.
Amaute khua a kipan ahong pawt ua, akiang lam azuanta uhi.
Huai kal in nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ne in," achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Na theih louh uh nek ding an ka nei," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite akihou ua, "Anek ding mi'n ahon tawi ua eita maw?" akichi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah agen a, "Hon sawlpa deihlam hihleh, ama nna sep zoh ding ka an ahi.
Nou, buhlakna ding kha li a-om lai, na chi uh hilou hia? Ngai un ka hon hilh ahi, dak unla loute en un, tu mahmah in lak ding in amin ahi.
Alapa'n loh amu a, tangtawn hinna ding in gah ala hi, huchi a atuhpa leh alapa akipah tuaktheihna ding un.
Khat in atuh a, midang in ala chih thu hiai ah adik hi.
Na sepgim louh uh at dia hon sawl ka hi; midang in asem ua, nou asepsa uh na sunzom uh ahi," achi hi.
Huan numei in, "Ka thilhih peuh hon hilh zel," chi a atheihsak thu ziak in huai khua a om Samari mi tampi in Jesu agingta uhi.
heading: Samarite Thuhilhna

paite: Huchi in Jesu kiang ah Samari mite ahong pai ua, akiang ua om ding in akhou ngutngut ua; huchi in huai ah ni nih ataam hi.
Huan midang tampi in amah thu ziak in agingta samta uhi.
Amau numei kiang ah, "Tu in zaw na thugen ziak a gingta ka hi kei uh; koumau ngei in athu ka za ua, hiai mipa Khrist, khovel Hondampa ngei ahi chih ka theita uh," achi uhi.
Huan ni nih nung in huai a pan pawt in, Galili gam ah apaita hi.
heading: Kapernaum Khua A Kumpi Milian Tapa Hihdamna

paite: Jesu ngei in, zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei chih atheihpih hi.
Huchi in Galili gam ahong tun in Galili gam mite'n ana kipahpih ua, Jerusalem a ankuanglui lai a athilhih tengteng amuh tak ziak un; amau mah leng ankuangluina ah ahoh sam uhi.
Galili gam a Kana khua, tui uain asuahsakna mun ahong tung nawnta hi. Kumpi milian kuahiam a-om a, Kapernaum ah atapa achina hi.
Judia gam a kipan Galili gam ah Jesu ahong chih azak in akiang ah ahohtou a, va hohsuk a atapa si dekdek hihdam ding in achial hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na muh kei uleh na gingta kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Kumpi milian in akiang ah, "Pu, ka ta asih ma in hong suk mai in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai nawnta in, na tapa adamta," achi hi. Huai mipa'n, Jesu'n akiang a thu agen agingta a, apaita hi.
Apaisuk lai in asikhate'n ana dawn ua, "Na tapa adamta," ana chi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah adam tung lai adong hi. Amau akiang ah, "Zan in dak sagihna ah akhosik ahong daita hi," achi uhi.
Naupang pa'n Jesu'n akiang a, "Na tapa adamta hi,” achih lai ahi chih atheita a; amah leh a-inkuanpihte'n avek un, agingtata uhi.
Hiai Judia gam a kipan Galili gam a ahong a Jesu thillamdang hih anihveina ahi.
